about: Stage E4e staging for data/targets.json (proposal; applied by the integrator, this branch never edits targets.json). One row: T-HUN-1's band rescaled to the model's adult males after the target audit (docs/staging/e4e-prereg.md §2). The original band is kept under `revisions`. Seen when this was written: B 26.8 and R 39.7 observed hunts per community-year (5-seed confirm, handoff §3); no run of this stage's changed model. Applying it changes the targets hash: protocolLog entry and new freeze by the integrator.

targets.definition: Observed hunts of red colobus ÷ community-days with a follow × 365.

accept.units: per community-year at the field profile's mean of 4.7 adult males (equivalently 0.9-2.3 per adult male-year)
accept.basis: Kanyawara and Ngogo per adult male-year, scaled linearly to the model's adult males (derived)

targets.notes: The code comment "62 hunts in 471 days with ~24 males" counts 62 hunting episodes and attempts, of which 13 were finds of chimpanzees already eating meat or carrying carcasses; the paper reports 26 adult males. C7a review (finding 7): flagged revised post hoc; log: C5a party-follow team set (source methods, post-freeze, fitted) and the C6 lite party follows at 2-min points. Stage E4e audit (2 October 2026; docs/staging/e4e-prereg.md §2.3): the band 5-25 labelled 'Kanyawara scaled' brackets the unscaled Kanyawara figure (10.4 per year at 11.4 adult males) and was never scaled to the model's 3-7 males; hunting rises with males within and across sites, so the scaling goes down. Derived: Kanyawara 10.4 / 11.4 = 0.91 and Ngogo about 55 / 24 = 2.3 hunts per adult male-year (45.1 successful hunts at 0.82 success); at the field profile's 7, 4 and 3 adult males (mean 4.7) that is 4-11 per community-year. Linear scaling is generous to the smallest communities (per-encounter odds rise with males). Alternative for the integrator: score the row per adult male-year (hunts / sum over follow-days of the community's adult males x 365). T-HUN-1 and T-HUN-3 are tied by the colobus encounter rate (about 3 x Kanyawara's per follow-hour in the model), so both cannot pass with either band until that rate is resolved.

revisions.reason: scaling audit: the band was not scaled to the model's adult males
